rune_flame.name: Infernal Flame Rune
rune_flame.desc: An ancient elemental rune glowing with fire. Socket into a weapon to grant +25% Damage and ignite enemies with persistent Burn DoT.

rune_frost.name: Glacial Frost Rune
rune_frost.desc: An icy elemental rune frozen for millennia. Socket into a weapon to inflict 40% Chill Slow for 3.5s and 25% chance to Freeze enemies solid.

rune_tempest.name: Tempest Surge Rune
rune_tempest.desc: A crackling elemental rune brimming with lightning. Socket into a weapon to grant -20% Skill Cooldown reduction and +10% Electric Shock Damage.

rune_vampiric.name: Vampiric Drain Rune
rune_vampiric.desc: A dark mystical rune pulsing with shadow thirst. Socket into a weapon to restore 25% of all damage dealt as immediate HP life leech.

socket_expander.name: Ancient Socket Expander
socket_expander.desc: Rare prehistoric drill crafted by titan smiths. Attempt to drill +1 socket into a weapon (up to 4 max). Warning: has a chance to break the socket slot on failure!

rune_bulwark.name: Bulwark Rune
rune_bulwark.desc: A heavy rune of packed earth. Socket into armor for +6% Max HP.

rune_aegis.name: Aegis Rune
rune_aegis.desc: A rune etched with an iron ward. Socket into armor for +8% Defense.

rune_thorns.name: Thorns Rune
rune_thorns.desc: A rune of brambles. Socket into armor: each monster blow you take hits back for 3% of your Max HP.

rune_renewal.name: Renewal Rune
rune_renewal.desc: A rune of spring water. Socket into armor for +35% HP regeneration.

rune_warding.name: Warding Rune
rune_warding.desc: A rune of old wards. Socket into armor for +6% resistance to every element.

rune_swiftness.name: Swiftness Rune
rune_swiftness.desc: A rune light as a feather. Socket into armor for +0.25 Move Speed.
